intro.data: Look up a user's email, then look up that email's host. Each lookup returns a BOX (it might fail). 'bind' chains them: run the first, feed its contents into the next, flatten the result. Two test cases keep you honest — Ada has a host, but Bo does NOT. The faithful bind finds Ada's host AND reports Nothing for Bo. A bind that invents a host passes Ada but FAILS Bo. Make both cases pass.
intro.alchemy: Distil a herb's essence, then distil that essence's salt. Each step returns a VIAL (it might be empty). 'bind' chains them. Two cases keep you honest — Sage yields a salt, but Rue does NOT. The faithful bind finds Sage's salt AND reports empty for Rue. A bind that invents a salt passes Sage but FAILS Rue. Make both cases pass.
intro.spellcraft: Divine a rune's omen, then divine that omen's sign. Each step returns a CHARM (it might fizzle). 'bind' chains them. Two cases keep you honest — Ash yields a sign, but Bramble does NOT. The faithful bind finds Ash's sign AND reports dark for Bramble. A bind that invents a sign passes Ash but FAILS Bramble. Make both cases pass.
intro.abstract: Compose f : A → T(B) with bind g : T(B) → T(C). Two cases: one input whose chain succeeds, one whose second step yields ∅. Only a bind that respects the box passes both; a fabricating bind passes the success case but fails the empty one.

goal.data: Build one pipeline that finds Ada's host AND reports Nothing for Bo.
goal.alchemy: Build one pipeline that finds Sage's salt AND reports empty for Rue.
goal.spellcraft: Build one pipeline that finds Ash's sign AND reports dark for Bramble.
goal.abstract: Pass both the success case and the short-circuit case.

afterSuccess.data: Both cases passed with ONE pipeline: bind ran the host lookup on the email inside the box, and when Bo had no host it honestly reported Nothing. The 'Invent Host' bind sailed through Ada but failed Bo — a single happy-path test would have missed it. That's why bind threads the 'might be empty' through every step automatically.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Both cases passed with one pipeline: bind worked on the essence inside the vial, and when Rue had no salt it honestly reported empty. 'Invent Salt' passed Sage but failed Rue.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Both cases passed with one working: bind worked on the omen inside the charm, and when Bramble had no sign it honestly reported dark. 'Invent Sign' passed Ash but failed Bramble.
afterSuccess.abstract: f then bind g passed both the success case and the short-circuit case; bind = join ∘ T(g) propagates ∅. A fabricating bind only fails on the empty case — which is exactly why the empty case is in the suite.

reveal.summary: bind chains a step that returns a box: bind : T(A) → (A → T(B)) → T(B), mapping the step over the box then flattening (join). Crucially it threads the effect — here 'might be empty' — through every step, so failure propagates instead of being papered over.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: user.flatMap(getEmail).flatMap(getHost) — one missing link yields None, with no host invented.
